necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation in the setting of a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction. Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances to guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management. This service is medically necessary to address the specific clinical indication of capturing intermittent arrhythmic events despite the denial based on Reason Code PR-204.
